archimate:BusinessFunction.name: generate lead
archimate:BusinessFunction.documentation:
In a modern sales pipeline, a lead is an unqualified contact who has shown initial interest (or whose contact details you have captured), whereas a prospect is a qualified lead who matches your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and has entered active, two-way communication with your sales team.
Put simply: every prospect starts as a lead, but not every lead becomes a prospect.
